text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is providing an update on plans to construct a multi-use trail connection along Lake Shore Boulevard East to close a gap in the Lake Shore Boulevard East Trail between Cherry Street and the Don River bridge, and seeking authority to install a necessary pedestrian and cyclist traffic control signal on Lake Shore Boulevard East. This report also responds to City Council's request on November 12 and 13, 2025 for a report on public realm improvement plans along Lake Shore Boulevard East, between Carlaw Avenue and Leslie Street.
City Council on April 22 and 23, 2026, referred Item TE31.54 to the April 30, 2026, meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council.
